data: Does the translation accuracy of InferSent (Transfer) model exceed 80% when trained on 0.5M parallel sentences?

The caption states that the legend shows the average accuracies of each model using 1M parallel sentences. However, the question asks about the accuracy of the InferSent (Transfer) model when trained on 0.5M parallel sentences. Therefore, we need to look at the data points for the InferSent (Transfer) model at the 0.5M mark on the x-axis. From the graph, the accuracy of the InferSent (Transfer) model is approximately 85.99%, which exceeds 80%.
